comment: Extracts data from AAC bit streams with ADTS framing.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING
variables.comment:
* Flag to force enable seeking using a constant bitrate assumption in cases where seeking would * otherwise not be possible. * *

Note that this approach may result in approximated stream duration and seek position that * are not precise, especially when the stream bitrate varies a lot.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING_ALWAYS
variables.comment:
* Like {@link #FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING}, except that seeking is also enabled in * cases where the content length (and hence the duration of the media) is unknown. Application * code should ensure that requested seek positions are valid when using this flag, or be ready to * handle playback failures reported through {@link Player.Listener#onPlayerError} with {@link * PlaybackException#errorCode} set to {@link * PlaybackException#ERROR_CODE_IO_READ_POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE}. * *

If this flag is set, then the behavior enabled by {@link * #FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING} is implicitly enabled as well.

variables.name: MAX_SNIFF_BYTES
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of bytes to search when sniffing, excluding the header, before giving up.
   * Frame sizes are represented by 13-bit fields, so expect a valid frame in the first 8192 bytes.

variables.name: NUM_FRAMES_FOR_AVERAGE_FRAME_SIZE
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of frames to use when calculating the average frame size for constant
   * bitrate seeking.
